diagnostic_evidence.quote: Let $k \geq 1$ and let $\delta \in (0,\infty]$. Consider $\varepsilon$-fine Whitney sets $\{q_j^\pm\}_{j = 1}^\infty \subset \Omega^\pm$ for $\Omega^\pm_\delta$ with respect to $\gamma$.
By Theorem~\ref{thm:lusin_frame}, case $\delta = \infty$, $\mathcal{F} \cup \{\phi_j^+\}_{j = 1}^{\infty} \cup \{\phi_j^-\}_{j = 1}^{J}$ is a frame for $L_2(\gamma)$,
Let $b_j^+$ be the normalizing constant for $\psi^+_j$, so that $|b_j^+|^2 \simeq d(q_j^-)^{2k-1}m(B_j)$, where $B_j = B(q_j^-,\varepsilon d(q_j^-))$.

issues.failure_explanation: For δ=∞ the exterior Whitney set must cover all of the unbounded domain Ω⁻, so it contains infinitely many source points q_j⁻ with d(q_j⁻)→∞. For such points the normalization gives |b_j⁺|²=(∫_γ|w−q_j⁻|^{−2k−2}|dw|)^{−1}≃d(q_j⁻)^{2k+2} (all factors |w−q_j⁻| are comparable to d(q_j⁻) once d(q_j⁻)≳diam γ), not d(q_j⁻)^{2k+1} as the proof's key equivalence claims; that equivalence holds only at distance ≲diam γ. The asserted 'analogous' exterior case of the discretization estimate is therefore false: each far normalized wavelet ψ_j⁺=b_j⁺(w−q_j⁻)^{−k−1} is asymptotically a unimodular constant on γ, so |(1,ψ_j⁺)|≍|γ|^{1/2}>0 for every one of the infinitely many far source points, giving Σ_j|(1,ψ_j⁺)|²=∞ (and likewise Σ_j|(f,ψ_j⁺)|²=∞ whenever ∫_γ f dσ≠0). Hence the upper frame (Bessel) bound fails and the δ=∞ case of the theorem is false (note the continuous square-function estimate of Theorem thm:square_function_estimates-1 remains finite at δ=∞, so the failure is genuinely in the discretization). Moreover the δ<∞ case is not proved independently: it extends the Whitney sets to all of Ω± and invokes the false δ=∞ case, and the removal lemma it relies on justifies compactness of U₂ through the same false equivalence |b_j⁺|²≃d(q_j⁻)^{2k−1}m(B_j).

failure_location.quote: We prove this estimate for the case of $\sum_{j=1}^\infty |b_j^- F^{(k)}(q^+_j)|^2$; the other case, where $+$ is replaced by $-$, and vice versa, is analogous.

issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Restrict Theorem thm:lusin_frame to δ<∞ and prove the discretization directly at the same fixed δ: discretize the two strip integrals of Theorem thm:square_function_estimates-1 (valid for all δ) over the Whitney balls covering Ω_δ^±, absorb the Poincaré–Wirtinger defect via Lemma lem:k+1_norm_less_than_k_norm applied to the strip domains Ω_δ^± (whose own boundary distance is ≤d(·,γ) and comparable to d on the small covering balls), and bound the finitely many source points at distance ≳diam(γ) crudely; delete the δ=∞ statement and the reduction through the removal lemma. This keeps ε₀ universal and recovers all advertised frames.
issues.overall_effect: The δ=∞ case of Theorem thm:lusin_frame is false, and the proof of the (true) δ<∞ cases collapses since it is reduced to the δ=∞ case; hence the paper's main frame theorem is unproven as written for every δ. The same false normalization invalidates the proof of Lemma lem:removal_of_lusin_wavelets_at_a_positive_distance_from_gamma, and Proposition prop:frames_for_hardy_spaces (the frames for L_2^±(γ)) together with the WMFS solvability theory of Sections 4–5 loses its support, although the δ<∞ statements remain true and provable by a modified argument.
issues.title: Lusin frame theorem fails for δ=∞: exterior Bessel bound breaks for far source points, and the δ<∞ proof depends on the δ=∞ case
issues.why_classification: A stated regime (δ=∞) is false and must be abandoned, and the main theorem needs a reorganized but contained new proof (the same square-function discretization localized to strips); no new global proof architecture is required and every advertised result—frames for Whitney sets accumulating at the boundary, Proposition prop:frames_for_hardy_spaces for δ<∞, and the WMFS method and numerics—survives unchanged, so the mathematical loss is limited to a regime used nowhere else in the paper.

issues.failure_explanation: For a bi-Lipschitz map ρ with L=max(Lip ρ, Lip ρ⁻¹), the measure bound is m(ρ(E))≥L^{−n}m(E) (singular values of Dρ are ≥1/L, so |det Dρ|≥L^{−n}), not L^{−1}m(E): e.g., ρ=(1/2)I on ℝ² has L=2 and m(ρ(E))=¼m(E)<½m(E). The displayed chain is therefore invalid for n≥2, and the stated covering constant N≤4ⁿL^{3n+1}σ is unsupported; the correct bound coming from the argument is N≤4ⁿL^{4n}σ.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Replace the Jacobian estimate by m(ρ(E_j))≥L^{−n}m(E_j) and change the lemma's stated bound to N≤4ⁿL^{4n}σ; the rest of the argument and all applications stand unchanged.
issues.overall_effect: Only the explicit covering constant in Lemma lem:whitney_set_under_bilip_map (and hence the quantitative constant in the verification of Example ex:explicit_whitney_partition) is wrong; the qualitative conclusion that the image set is a Whitney set with finite covering constant is unaffected, and no downstream result uses the explicit bound.
issues.title: Wrong Jacobian power in bi-Lipschitz image of Whitney sets gives a false quantitative covering bound
issues.why_classification: The repair is a local one-line correction of an exponent in a quantitative estimate; the qualitative Whitney conclusion, the method, and every downstream claim survive with no other change.
